home.headline: Toothache? Understand it before you see a dentist.
home.intro: Describe your problem in your own words. We explain how urgent it is, what it may be, what it might cost, and whether BPJS covers it.
home.consent: Educational information, not a diagnosis. Your complaint, typed or as a voice note, is not stored and is processed by Google AI outside Indonesia.
home.complaintPlaceholder: Example: my lower left molar has been throbbing for three days and hurts more at night
home.complaintHint: Write in Indonesian, a regional language, or English.

home.voiceFailed: Recording did not work. Try again, or type your complaint.

testimonyForm.metaDescription: Write a Testimony about a dentist you visited.
testimonyForm.entryHint: Been to a dentist? Share your experience so other patients can choose with confidence.
testimonyForm.title: Share your experience
testimonyForm.intro: Write honestly about a dental practice you visited. You only sign in with Google when you press Send.
testimonyForm.providerReadOnly: The place you are writing about
testimonyForm.textHint: Write as much as you need. Leave out phone numbers and other patients' names.
testimonyForm.visitHint: Month and year are enough, so you are harder to identify.
testimonyForm.photosLabel: Photos of the practice (optional, up to {{max}})
testimonyForm.photosGuidance: Only the waiting room, treatment room, equipment or signboard. No faces, receipts or screenshots. Location data is removed from photos automatically.
testimonyForm.photosReattach: Photos and proof of visit are not kept in the draft. Choose them again before sending.
testimonyForm.proofHint: A receipt, invoice or appointment screenshot, as an image or PDF. Never shown: it is checked and then deleted right away. If it matches, your Testimony gets the Verified visit mark.
testimonyForm.displayNameHint: Initials are recommended, so the practice cannot identify you.
testimonyForm.consentHonest: This is my own experience, written honestly.
testimonyForm.consentNoOthers: My text and photos contain no one else's personal data.
testimonyForm.signInNote: When you press Send, you sign in with Google. Your account is never shown.
